person.name: Onur Koç
person.intro: Design of underground structures for rail, road, energy and water supply, from early studies through construction, and independent checking of structural designs.

profile.summary: More than 18 years of experience in tunnelling and underground construction, with projects in Europe, North and South America, the Middle East and North Africa, including the Semmering Base Tunnel, the Eurasia Tunnel in Istanbul, the Granitztal tunnel chain of the Koralm Railway and hydropower projects in Israel and Chile. Currently leads a team of five engineers and carries out independent checking of structural designs for SBB infrastructure projects.
key_skills: Underground works for hydropower: steel-lined pressure shaft, pressure tunnels, surge tank
Independent checking of structural designs (Category 3 check)

projects.name: Gare de Lausanne (Nouveau Métro)
projects.description: As part of the SBB programme «Léman 2030», Lausanne station is being comprehensively renewed: new platforms and underpasses while train operations continue. First section in service in 2030, full completion by 2037.
projects.services: Independent checking of the structural calculations (equivalent to a Category 3 check, UK): bored pile walls, micropiles, top-down construction, excavation support; geotechnical inspection; risk management

projects.name: Alto Maipo Hydropower Project
projects.description: Short-term assignment of three months during construction.
projects.services: Evaluation and assessment of a tunnel collapse

projects.name: AQUANOVO drinking water supply, Zurich
projects.description: Planning of a new drinking water transmission main for the City of Zurich. Comparison of seven construction variants (1A–2B) using microtunnelling, horizontal directional drilling, TBM and open-cut construction.
projects.services: Variant evaluation, alignment planning, interactive visualisation (longitudinal profile, alignment), construction concept

projects.name: Cargo sous terrain
projects.description: Underground network for automated, electric freight transport in Switzerland. The design covers a 75 km single-tube tunnel, mostly bored by TBM with SCL sections, plus shafts and portals.
projects.services: Project management, variant planning, tunnel concept

projects.name: Various tunnel and infrastructure projects
projects.description: Fideris tunnel (RhB): risk analysis with risk matrix. Täsch–Zermatt (Matterhorn Gotthard Bahn): variant analysis. Le Locle tunnel (CSC/Webuild): construction concept incl. concept for karst cavities during TBM drive. Swissgrid Innertkirchen, lots 1 and 2: tender analysis.
projects.services: Risk analysis, construction concepts, bid preparation, variant planning

projects.name: Manara Pumped Storage Power Plant
projects.description: Pumped storage plant in northern Israel with a single 156 MW pump turbine: upper and lower reservoirs, powerhouse cavern, low- and high-pressure waterways, surge tank and access tunnel.
projects.services: Led a team of three engineers (scope, budget). Design of the steel liner in the high-pressure shaft, high-pressure tunnel, low-pressure tunnel, access tunnel and surge tank; contribution to the powerhouse cavern

projects.name: Effluent Outfall Tunnel, Los Angeles
projects.description: Effluent outfall tunnel for the Joint Water Pollution Control Plant (JWPCP), about 12.9 km (8 miles) long, about 5.5 m (18 ft) in diameter. First use in the USA of post-tensioned segmental lining, over up to 40 % of the alignment.
projects.services: Design of starter and tail tunnels for the TBM launch; risk assessment and mitigation design for the TBM drive in squeezing ground

projects.name: French Hill Tunnels, Jerusalem
projects.description: Two twin tunnels with a total length of 3.5 km beneath one of Jerusalem's busiest junctions, passing under roads 1 and 60, the Uzi Narkis bridge and the LRT tracks. Excavation with low rock cover and in fill, temporary access tunnel, up to 12 headings at the same time.
projects.services: Detailed geotechnical and structural design of excavation and support (NATM)

projects.name: Eglinton Crosstown LRT, Toronto
projects.client: CTSC: SNC-Lavalin, Dragados, Aecon, EllisDon JV
projects.description: Light rail line in the Greater Toronto Area: 19 km corridor along Eglinton Avenue with 15 underground stations and a 10 km twin-bored tunnel.
projects.services: Design of the false ceiling connections and reinforced concrete design

projects.name: Purple (D) Line, Section III, Los Angeles
projects.client: Los Angeles County Metropolitan Transportation Authority (LACMTA)
projects.description: Heavy rail line of about 3.7 km (2.32 miles), double track, with tunnels and 13 cross passages. The cross passages require dewatering and ground improvement; excavation and support follow SEM principles.
projects.services: Analysis and design of the cross passages

projects.name: Vienna metro U5/U2, stations
projects.description: Two new underground stations in the city centre, beneath multi-storey commercial buildings.
projects.services: 3D structural analysis of the stations; settlement analysis of the surface buildings

projects.name: Koralm Railway, Granitztal tunnel chain, BL 50.4
projects.description: Total length about 6.5 km. The cut-and-cover tunnel, about 600 m long, connects two mined tunnels of the high-speed line.
projects.services: Analysis and design of the cut-and-cover tunnel and the tunnel bridge

projects.name: Geisswand road tunnel
projects.description: Road tunnel of about 2.2 km, two lanes, excavated cross-section 76 m² (NATM).
projects.services: Rehabilitation of floor heave caused by swelling; design of the road pavement against swelling pressure

projects.name: Arlberg road tunnel
projects.description: At 13.976 km, Austria's longest road tunnel (S16, Tyrol–Vorarlberg).
projects.services: Structural analysis for the tunnel rehabilitation (components of the rehabilitation concept)

projects.name: Gleinalm road tunnel
projects.description: Motorway tunnel on the A9 Pyhrn in Styria, 8.32 km long. New second tube (opened 2017), followed by rehabilitation of the existing tube.
projects.services: Analysis of the final lining of the new tube; rehabilitation of the existing tube

projects.name: Semmering Base Tunnel
projects.description: Railway tunnel of 27.3 km between Gloggnitz and Mürzzuschlag, two tubes, in difficult geological conditions.
projects.services: 3D analysis of the drive through the fault zone; analysis of the NATM and TBM cross-sections; analysis of the final lining

projects.name: Eurasia Tunnel (Istanbul Strait Road Crossing), NATM section
projects.description: Double-deck road tunnel of 5.4 km beneath the Bosphorus, down to −106 m; total route 14.6 km between Kumkapı (Europe) and Koşuyolu, Kadıköy (Asia).
projects.services: Analysis and design of primary and final lining in the NATM section, incl. intersections; design of cut-and-cover sections

projects.name: Himmelreich tunnel
projects.description: Tunnel of about 1,045 m on the Hausmannstätten bypass (B73, Styria).
projects.services: Analysis and design of the tunnel cross-sections; formwork stripping analysis of the false ceiling (stripping time)

projects.name: Road tunnels T2 and T3, upgrade of RN43, Bejaia
projects.description: Upgrade of a coastal road along a cliff: tunnels T1 (880 m), T2 (635 m), T3 (268 m) and escape tunnels E1 (137 m) and E2 (145 m), in heavily karstified limestone, block breccia and folded clay- and siltstone. Portals and alignment were optimised in option studies.
projects.services: Analysis of the typical cross-sections

projects.name: A10 Tauern motorway, Tauern road tunnel
projects.description: Twin-tube road tunnel of 6,546 m in the province of Salzburg, two lanes per tube.
projects.services: Analysis and design of the final lining, false ceiling and ventilation cavern; analysis and design of a retention dam

publications.title: French Hill Road Tunnels: A Pragmatic Rock Support Approach

publications.title: Istanbul Strait Road Tube Crossing: Design of NATM Tunnels and Asian Transition Box Excavation
Strategies for Design of the Support Measures in Tunneling on Basis of Eurocode
